system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

svg.text: GitHub labels pass the baton: whoever the label points to moves next. Every step is explained below.

g.text: 1 Open an issue · label now: none yet

text.font-family: system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: Open a new issue on GitHub and say what you want done.

text.font-family: system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: A new issue waits for you to hand it over; the daemon leaves it alone (unless the project runs greedy mode).

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Noto Serif CJK SC', 'Songti SC', serif

g.text: 2 You label it · label now: pending/agent

text.font-family: system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: Label the issue pending/agent, meaning "hand this to the agent".

text.font-family: system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: It is the one and only switch: without this label nothing happens.

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Noto Serif CJK SC', 'Songti SC', serif
system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: A local timer wakes the poller every 60 s by default (configurable); a quiet repo slows it down.

text.font-family: system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: Polling only calls the GitHub API, never a model, so idle time costs no model spend.

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Noto Serif CJK SC', 'Songti SC', serif
system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: The issue gets its own worktree, tmux session and agent session.

text.font-family: system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: Only once it is confirmed alive does the label flip to doing/agent; if it dies, pending/human.

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Noto Serif CJK SC', 'Songti SC', serif
system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: The worker reads the code and posts a plan with the choices for you. No code yet; every project has this step.

text.font-family: system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: With design review on it flips to pending/review for review; otherwise straight to pending/human and step 7.

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Noto Serif CJK SC', 'Songti SC', serif
system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: Another model (codex by default, configurable) reviews the plan; a fail bounces it back to 5, at most 3 rounds.

text.font-family: system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: Only a pass (or the last round) flips it to pending/human for you. Optional: only with design review on.

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Noto Serif CJK SC', 'Songti SC', serif
system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: Tick the options in the comment, or reply with changes,

text.font-family: system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: then relabel pending/agent; the worker carries on at the next poll.

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Noto Serif CJK SC', 'Songti SC', serif

g.text: 8 Build + open PR · label now: pending/PR

text.font-family: system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: The worker writes tests first, then code; the PR opens once the tests are green. The issue moves to pending/PR.

text.font-family: system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: With a review gate the PR is reviewed first, then handed to you.

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Noto Serif CJK SC', 'Songti SC', serif
system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: Once you merge, the daemon cleans up the worktree and tmux session.

text.font-family: system-ui, 'PingFang SC', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif

g.text: The PR is labeled Done and the issue closes with it.
